question: Which diverse beings are included among those associated with this teaching?
premises: Several classes of beings are enumerated.
The list includes celestial, semi-divine, and demonic beings.
Ascetics are also included in the list.
inference: Gandharvas, kinnaras, yakshas, asuras, and ascetics are all included.
uncertainties: The grammatical role of this list depends on the following verses.
plain_english: Gandharvas, kinnaras, yakshas, asuras, and ascetics.
